note: What each guard CANNOT catch. Every bug on 2026-08-23 was a check that was right in principle and asked a question whose answer could not reveal the fault — not a broken guard, a guard aimed slightly beside the thing it guards. We declare blind spots for every agent and declared none for guards, so a guard asking the wrong question looked identical to one that works.
law: Writing the sentence IS the work. Anybody made to write 'measures elapsed time, not whether a scheduled run happened' would have seen the gap before it cost a morning. A blind spot too vague to reveal a gap is not a blind spot.

schema-guard.mjs.cannotCatch: Values. A file with every key present and an index of 8,123,456 passes every structural test ever written — shape checking cannot see whether a number is absurd.

flag-guard.mjs.cannotCatch: A gate that is registered, owned, documented and simply wrong. It verifies each flag exists once with an owner and a trigger; it has no view on whether the trigger is the right trigger.

memory-guard.mjs.cannotCatch: Whether a law is CORRECT. It checks the knowledge base is current, readable and cross-referenced. A wrong law, perfectly formatted and reachable from the entry point, passes cleanly.
memory-guard.mjs.coveredBy: the falsifier, and being wrong in public

competence-guard.mjs.cannotCatch: Whether a declared principle is TRUE. It enforces that every specialist declares sourced principles, failure modes, blind spots and a recheck date. A confidently wrong principle with a real citation passes.
competence-guard.mjs.coveredBy: the teacher, and the recheck date

knowledge-guard.mjs.cannotCatch: Whether a source is any good. It requires every fact to carry sources, a date and a falsifier. Three secondary sources agreeing with each other satisfied it — and our own catalogue disproved the number.
knowledge-guard.mjs.coveredBy: verify-work's secondary-consensus check, added after exactly that

content-sanity.mjs.cannotCatch: Whether prose is GOOD. It catches labels in prose slots, unresolved templates, truncation and copy too short to be an explanation. A fluent, well-formed, entirely wrong sentence passes.

layout-check.mjs.cannotCatch: Whether a design looks GOOD. It measures clipping, overlap and empty panels against real font metrics. Geometry is not taste and a balanced, ugly page passes.

card-guard.mjs.cannotCatch: Whether the IMAGE is right. It reads the SVG source, so a card back served as a 200 PNG at correct dimensions passed everything — the bytes were valid and the picture was of the wrong thing.
card-guard.mjs.coveredBy: reading image URLs from source data rather than constructing them, and eyes

slop-guard.mjs.cannotCatch: A grouping that IS in the data and still means nothing. It enforces that every grouping derives from a held field or an openly stored list; a technically-derived and utterly boring grouping passes.

verify-work.mjs.cannotCatch: Reasoning. It checks whether output carries what a defensible claim must carry. The pooled-cohort error that nearly retired a correct thesis would have passed it cleanly.
verify-work.mjs.coveredBy: the decision log, which grades predictions rather than logic

bias-guard.mjs.cannotCatch: Its own bias. It was written by the same party it audits, and its measure of whether the machines are calibrated is a count the machines produce.
bias-guard.mjs.coveredBy: Tyler catching what the machines miss — the ratio IS the score

publish-assert.mjs.cannotCatch: Anything published through a path it does not read. Hand-minted cards went straight to Tyler twice, once with a wrong price and once meaningless, and this never saw either.
publish-assert.mjs.coveredBy: verify-work's ungated-publication check, added after exactly that

windowless-price-guard.mjs.cannotCatch: A figure with a window that is WRONG. It requires a date range; it cannot tell whether the range is accurate or whether the provider is describing it honestly.
windowless-price-guard.mjs.coveredBy: the graded-window probe, which measures rather than asks

domain-plausibility.mjs.cannotCatch: An implausible value that is nevertheless true. Its rules encode what we believe about the hobby, so a genuine market shock reads as a filter fault — it names our own filter as first suspect, which is right almost always and wrong sometimes.

guard-audit.mjs.cannotCatch: Whether a wired guard asks the right question. It verifies guards exist, are connected and run in order. The heartbeat was wired, ordered, running — and green through a failed run.

heartbeat.mjs.cannotCatch: A run that fires, succeeds, and produces wrong data. It now detects missed scheduled runs; it has no view on whether a completed run did anything useful.
knownPatterns: elapsed time as a proxy for an event
heartbeat.mjs.history: Allowed 30 hours so a LATE run would not cry wolf, which is exactly the window a SKIPPED run hides in. Reported green through a failed fetch on 2026-08-23.

qa-gate.mjs.cannotCatch: A number that is fresh, thick and wrong. It checks sample size, staleness and coverage — 26 listings kept from 150 fetched cleared every threshold while our own filter had eaten the market.

voice-lint.mjs.cannotCatch: Copy that is on-voice and says nothing. It catches hype, hedging and forbidden phrasing. The word 'chase' published as an entire explanation passed it — perfectly on-voice, perfectly meaningless.

jargon-lint.mjs.cannotCatch: A term we have taught badly. It flags unexplained jargon; it cannot tell whether the explanation given is any good, and 'the 9 rarely pays — only the 10' had a tooltip nobody could parse.

falsifier.mjs.cannotCatch: A thesis it is testing WRONGLY. It reported RT-5 TRIPPED because it pooled two cohorts the thesis explicitly contrasts — the thesis was 11 of 12 accurate and the test was measuring the average of a contrast. It matches card names when splitting RT-5 cohorts, which is the substring shape — mitigated by word boundaries and a hand-checked twelve-card set, and worth revisiting the moment that set grows.
falsifier.mjs.coveredBy: the contrastive-thesis guard in negative-tests, added after exactly that

correction-hunter.mjs.cannotCatch: A figure that never moves. It re-checks published numbers that changed; a price frozen for a month is a claim too, and it is invisible here.
correction-hunter.mjs.coveredBy: the teacher raised exactly this question

rasterize-cards.mjs.cannotCatch: Whether the rendered image is CORRECT. It confirms a PNG was produced at the right size. A card back renders identically to a card front.
rasterize-cards.mjs.coveredBy: reading image URLs from source, and eyes

build-corrections.mjs.cannotCatch: NOT A GUARD. It generates the public corrections page. Listed in the audit because the audit tracks pipeline steps as well as checks, and conflating the two is how a generator gets read as a safety net. It also writes font stacks in the shorthand form, which is the shape that let four pages render headings in Times — acknowledged and fixed, kept on the record because the shape recurs.
